events.title: Daimler Truck Q1 2026 earnings hurt by U.S. tariffs
events.body: Adjusted operating profit fell by more than half in Q1, with the North American division absorbing at least €100 million in tariff costs

events.title: Daimler Truck Maintains Guidance After Strong Start to Year in U.S.
events.body: Daimler Truck backed its guidance as first-quarter order growth was fueled by a strong recovery in the U.S., which the company expects will continue to boost its performance in the quarters ahead.

events.title: Tesla finally gets Semi production moving at scale
events.body: Long-delayed EV truck finally enters high-volume phase

events.title: Toyota to join Daimler Truck, Volvo Group in fuel cell joint venture
events.body: The three companies plan to be equal shareholders in Cellcentric, accelerating the development of hydrogen technology for heavy-duty vehicles.
